description: Dashboard overview page with a date-range filter, a row of stat cards showing revenue/users/conversion/tickets with trend deltas, a recent activity feed, and a quick-links panel.
Login page with a centered card, email and password fields, forgot-password link, sign-in button, and a link to sign up.
Signup / register / create account page with a centered card, name, email, and password fields, terms notice, and a link to sign in.
Forgot password / reset password page with an email field, a send-reset-link button, and a confirmation state once the link is sent.
Account settings page with tabs for Profile, Notifications, and Billing — profile fields, notification toggle switches, and a current-plan summary with a manage-plan button.
Pricing / plans / subscription page with a monthly-vs-annual toggle and three pricing tiers (Starter, Pro, Enterprise) with a highlighted featured plan and feature lists.
User profile / my account page with an avatar, editable name/username/bio fields, a save button, and stat counts for posts/followers/following.
List with detail / directory / catalog page: a searchable list of items on the left with status badges, and a detail panel on the right showing the selected item's fields.
Onboarding / welcome / get-started walkthrough with a multi-step wizard, progress dots, back/continue navigation, and a skip option.
Checkout / cart / payment page with a card-details form (cardholder, card number, expiry, CVC), an order summary with line items, and a total-due pay button.
Generic empty state / error page / 404 page / not-found page with an icon, a short title and description, and a recovery action button.
Home / landing page with a navbar, hero headline with call-to-action buttons, a feature grid, customer testimonials, a call-to-action section, and a footer.
